## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The rewritten `requirement_proven` has to be fixed before merge. It now returns `True` for an empty criteria list, so a requirement with no evidence is reported as proven. The base version returned `False` for that input. The new `reviewed_batch` helper and its tests check out, and its empty, all-true and mixed paths are covered.

## Critical
- app/proof.py:3 — correctness — `requirement_proven([])` now returns `True`, because `sum(...)` of an empty generator is `0`, which equals `len([])`. The base code `bool(criteria) and all(...)` returned `False` for this input. The new `test_requirement_with_evidence` only passes non-empty lists, so it cannot catch this. To fix it, restore the empty guard (e.g. `return bool(criteria) and all(item["proven"] for item in criteria)`) and add `assert not requirement_proven([])` to `tests/test_proof.py`. — Any requirement that has no criteria attached will be reported as proven. That silently overstates proof status, and no test protects the earlier behaviour.
